mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5 percentage points, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown where weak demand and constrained supply depress corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 205), the Federal Reserve's tightening of monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) leads to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 205 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand for housing, which reduces overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial contraction regime (INDPRO < 112.5), the decline in manufacturing output reduces corporate profit margins and future earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 112.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contraction in consumer spending and tighter monetary conditions, which together depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
